description: Withdraw wallet balance to the authenticated user's payout account. Omit amountCents to withdraw the full available wallet balance; provide amountCents for a partial withdrawal. Requires completed payout setup and RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY. Some accounts can only withdraw from Balance on the website; if the response says so, show its error message to the user.

amountCents.description: a number less than or equal to 1000000
amountCents.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(1000000)
